# cloudaxion_vm_images (Data Source)

The VM image catalogue.

CloudAxion has no image identifier: a `cloudaxion_vm` selects its image by the `os_name`/`os_version` pair, and this data source is how to discover valid pairs. The catalogue includes both plain operating systems and preinstalled applications.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# CloudAxion has no image identifier: a VM picks its image by os_name/os_version.
data "cloudaxion_vm_images" "all" {}

output "ubuntu_versions" {
  value = flatten([
    for image in data.cloudaxion_vm_images.all.images : [
      for version in image.versions : version.os_version if version.published
    ] if image.os_name == "ubuntu"
  ])
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) Available image families. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `is_app_catalog` (Boolean) Whether this is a preinstalled application rather than a plain OS.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the platform default image.
- `os_name` (String) Value to pass as `os_name`.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Versions of this image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--images--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images.versions`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable version name.
- `os_version` (String) Value to pass as `os_version`.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the version is currently selectable.
